details: The "ARMA" Bill has been introduced by US lawmakers, aiming to establish a strategic Bitcoin reserve with a 20-year hold on 1 million BTC, potentially securing a $25 billion federal stash.
title: US Lawmakers Propose Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill

details: NEAR Protocol's native token surged over 20% in the past 24 hours, extending a multi-week rally driven by a renewed AI narrative, its focus on AI agents, privacy features, and upcoming network upgrades like dynamic resharding.
title: NEAR Protocol Surges Over 20% on AI Momentum & Upgrades

details: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF experienced a $70 million loss, extending an outflow streak to four days. This continuous institutional outflow suggests a weakening demand for Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds.
title: BlackRock Leads $70M Bitcoin ETF Loss Amid Outflow Streak

details: An exploiter of the Verus bridge returned 4,052 ETH, valued at approximately $8.5 million, to the project team after a settlement offer, while retaining 1,350 ETH, or about $2.8 million, as a bounty.
title: Verus Bridge Exploiter Returns $8.5M ETH, Keeps $2.8M Bounty

details: Trump Media & Technology Group moved 2,650 Bitcoin, worth approximately $205 million, to the Crypto.com exchange. This transaction has sparked fresh questions regarding the company's treasury management strategy, especially given reported unrealized losses on its Bitcoin holdings.
title: Trump Media Transfers 2,650 BTC to Crypto.com, Raises Questions
